summary: Iteration 65 — Backend-configurable credit margin verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass — GET /api/public/credit-pricing (no auth) returns expected shape (rows=7, packs=3, note, updated_at) with user_usd = base_usd × (1+margin) and credits = round(user_usd / upc) within rounding tolerance; GET /api/admin/billing-settings returns 200 for owner (amit@demo.team), 403 for member (raj@demo.team); PATCH credit_margin_pct=0.30 propagates immediately to /public/credit-pricing (note 'You pay base provider cost + 30% margin', all rows re-flow); clamps invalid values (5.0 → 2.0, -1.0 → 0.0); non-numeric strings dropped (margin unchanged); PATCH credit_usd_per_credit=0.0001 re-computes credits column ~10x. Frontend: home page (/) renders new <section data-testid='home-feature-glance'> as the SECOND section below Hero with the 12-tile 4-column grid on lg ('Dev OS', '13 AI engineers', 'Slash commands', '6-model AI synthesizer', 'Real GitHub PRs', 'Real deploys' all present); /pricing data-testid='pricing-margin-note' reflects live margin — 25% by default, switches to '30% margin' after admin PATCH; /dev-os-guide CreditCosts shows live '30% margin' copy, dynamic 3-pack tiles (Starter/Team/Scale) and the 7-row cost table (specialist_reply, devmgr_round, dev_fanout, scan, github_export, voice_min, image). Margin restored to 0.25 at end of run.
critical_code_review_comments: services/billing_settings.py is small and well-scoped: get_settings auto-seeds the singleton doc and merges with DEFAULTS so new provider_rates keys appear without a migration. Clamping happens server-side in update_settings (margin [0,2], upc [1e-5, 1.0]) which is the right place — frontend can't bypass.

compute_pricing_table rounds base_usd AFTER user_usd is computed (line 122-123). This means user_usd is from the unrounded base, while the table shows the rounded base. The displayed math (base × 1.25) is therefore approximate by up to ±0.0001 USD per row. Not a bug, but the problem-statement assertion 'user_usd ≈ base_usd × 1.25 within rounding' is exactly this case — the tests were relaxed accordingly (5e-4 tolerance).

Admin gate is duplicated in two handlers (GET + PATCH) with the same `if current['role'] not in ('owner','admin'): raise 403`. Minor — would be cleaner as a `require_admin` dependency, but not a blocker.

Pydantic model CreditMarginPatch types fields as Optional[float]. A non-numeric string would normally be rejected at 422 by Pydantic; the test_patch_drops_non_numeric_strings test handles both 200 (no-op) and 422 outcomes — current behaviour is 422 which is acceptable.

Home FeatureGlance uses a 4-col lg grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with 12 features — perfect 3 rows × 4 cols on desktop. Two icons reuse `ListChecks` ('Tasks + Kanban + Bugs' and 'Live presence'); minor visual repetition but title and copy are distinct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home FeatureGlance + pricing live margin + dev-os-guide live margin all verified, 0.25→0.30→0.25 round-trip)

seed_data_creation: None. The system_settings 'billing' doc is auto-seeded on first read of /public/credit-pricing if absent. After the test run, the doc was explicitly PATCHed back to credit_margin_pct=0.25 + credit_usd_per_credit=0.001 (verified via curl).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 65 is fully green. The billing settings doc lives in db.system_settings with id='billing'. Default margin=0.25, upc=0.001. To change margin at runtime: PATCH /api/admin/billing-settings {credit_margin_pct: 0.30} as amit (owner) — propagates instantly to /api/public/credit-pricing (no caching). Frontend pages /pricing and /dev-os-guide fetch this endpoint on mount; reload the page to see updated margin. To test 403 of admin endpoints, use raj@demo.team (role=member) — fresh signup users become OWNERS of a new workspace, so they will get 200 not 403 (this caused a test failure during first run; now fixed by using the seeded raj account). The pricing math has a subtle rounding artifact: row.user_usd is computed from the UNROUNDED base, then base_usd is rounded to 4dp. When asserting 'user_usd == base_usd × (1+m)' use a tolerance of at least 5e-4 USD per row. credits column may differ by ±1 from `round(displayed_user_usd / upc)` for the same reason.
rca of the issue: No production issues found. Three initial test failures were all test-side bugs and were corrected: (1) Member-403 test signed up a fresh user, but signup creates a NEW workspace so the new user becomes OWNER, not member — fixed by logging in as the seeded raj@demo.team. (2) & (3) Math tolerance was 1e-6 but the backend rounds base_usd to 4dp AFTER computing user_usd from the unrounded base, so the displayed math is approximate by up to 5e-4 USD and credits can be off by 1 — fixed by relaxing tolerances. Margin restoration at module-teardown works (verified curl shows margin=0.25 in clean state).
